Q: Font Awesome spinners icons not spinning A:

Alert!!!

Sometimes, even if the code is fine, your pc settings may be the culprit.

Make sure to on animation to actually see any form of animation to work.

You can change that setting in following ways:

For Windows 10

1. search for show animation in windows

2. Scroll down and there you see a radio button for showing animations or not.

For Windows 11

As suggested by @Mohammed 
settings -> Accessibility -> Visual Effects -> Turn on animation effects

For mac

As suggested by @ croceldon

https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/@media/prefers-reduced-motion#user_preferences

System Preferences > Accessibility > Display > Reduce motion.

Q: SELECT rows WHERE column contains the search string or column is a substring of the search string A:

Inverting the ordinary LIKE structure is nuanced (because you have to accommodate/escape wildcards in the column values) ...and ugly. Worse, you have to hardcode the escape expression.

WHERE col1 LIKE '%fox jumped over%' ESCAPE '!'
OR 'fox jumped over' LIKE CONCAT('%', REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(col1, '!', '!!'), '%', '!%'), '_', '!_'), '%') ESCAPE '!'

With this in mind, it may be more convenient to resort to a database dialect-suitable technique which doesn't involve wildcards.

SQL: SQLize Demo

WHERE INSTR(col1, 'fox jumped over') > 0
OR INSTR('fox jumped over', col1) > 0
